```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
spec <- fwf_empty(here("Holyoke", "B& T Standard FY 26 output (1)"))
df <- read_fwf(here("Holyoke", "B& T Standard FY 26 output (1)"), spec)
```
```{r}
# usecode: x19
# fueltype: x41
# areasq: x26
# storyheight:x28
```


```{r}
df_filter <- df %>%
  select(X19, X41, X26, X28) %>%
  rename(USECODE = X19, FUELTYPE = X41, AREASQ = X26, STORYHEIGHT = X28)
```

```{r}
write.csv(df_filter, file = "Holyoke_Final.csv")
```
